figure_contract.core_conclusion: Absolute-state pretraining learns residue-level flexibility and outperforms FastProtFlex on shared static tasks, whereas paired response remains weak and TCR3D provides only moderate proxy evidence.

statistics.panels_a_b_c: Point estimates are equal-system means; intervals are archived system-level nonparametric bootstrap 95% confidence intervals.
statistics.panel_d: The violin contains all correlatable chains. The orange point is the equal-chain mean and the whisker is the archived chain bootstrap 95% confidence interval.
statistics.hypothesis_tests: No p-values are asserted in this figure.
